description: This file defines a SettingsController class that manages application settings such as theme mode and compact mode, including loading from and saving to shared preferences.

classes.name: SettingsController
classes.description: A controller class that manages user settings such as theme mode and compact display mode, with persistence support.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads persisted app settings from SharedPreferences and updates internal state.

methods.name: setThemeMode
methods.description: Updates and persists the theme mode setting.

methods.name: setCompactMode
methods.description: Updates and persists the compact mode setting.

methods.name: _parseThemeMode
methods.description: Parses a string into a ThemeMode enum value.
